instruction:
Carry out `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed_dsp.cir` in native PSpice. Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. On this machine, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.

Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed_dsp.out`, `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed_dsp_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed_dsp.dat`. The native run contains two transient cases: `1 kHz @ 1.0 V` and `5 kHz @ 0.5 V`. From the measured `VINMAX/VINMIN/VOUTMAX/VOUTMIN` values in `C:\Users\user\Desktop\mixed_dsp_measure.txt`, write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\dsp_result.json` with `input_1kHz_V`, `input_5kHz_V`, `recon_1kHz_V`, `recon_5kHz_V`, `atten_1kHz_dB`, `atten_5kHz_dB`, `pass_1kHz_keep`, and `pass_5kHz_reject`. Set `pass_1kHz_keep` to true when `atten_1kHz_dB < 4.0` dB and `pass_5kHz_reject` to true when `atten_5kHz_dB > 12.0` dB; otherwise set the corresponding field to false.
